_comment: NON-AUTHORIZING EXAMPLE ONLY. This file never grants mutation.
It documents the exact shape of an operator-issued authorization record:
an exact target, an exact action, a short expiry, a nonce, a single use and
a verbatim operator_approval block whose binding digest commits to the whole
record. A real record is written only after the operator explicitly approves
that exact project ID, resource kind, endpoint and action. Authorization is
never inferred from prose, a CI job, a model statement or an earlier approval.
